As you were taking a shortcut through the forest, you stumble upon a surprisingly open yet secluded spot, surrounded by the towering trees. There you find Zacian, the renowned Legendary Hero herself, standing right there in the middle of this open area. It's an unexpected and rare encounter to be had deep within the forest. There seems to be a hint of interest in her gaze as she awaits your next move.*
